sp: K-Pop ballad. Digital synthesizers provide bright, bell-like pads and staccato brass-style stabs. piano enters. woodblock hits on upbeats. The vocal arrangement includes layered harmonies and rhythmic ad-libs during transitions. full band enters, driving drum beat. A steady mid-tempo drum kit provides a crisp backbeat with prominent hi-hat work.

sp: Orchestral soundtrack with a focus on woodwinds and strings. The guitar maintains a steady eighth-note arpeggio pattern throughout. arpeggiated synth fades with delay. reese bass modulates, half-time drum feel. Female vocals are clear and melodic, following the whistle's initial theme. A clean electric guitar provides sparse, arpeggiated accompaniment with light chorus and reverb. A clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a repetitive arpeggiated pattern in 4/4 time.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Fuego en la pista tonight
Moving to the bassline right
Every beat drops like a wave
Dancing till the break of day

[Chorus]
(vocals barely audible over guitars)
Swirling, swirling, lost in sound
Drowning in the beautiful
